title: Lunar polar scout: default event set
assumptions: Two declared scenario events (a permanently shadowed region pass during science and a lunar eclipse during the contact period) occur on days drawn from independent seeded scenario streams; they are the only random element of the run.
The scenario events are illustrative narrative, not an ephemeris prediction.

scenarioEvents.title: Permanently shadowed region pass
scenarioEvents.situation: The ground track crosses a permanently shadowed crater: the coldest, most valuable terrain, but the instruments need heater power to observe it.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Skip the cold pass or heat the instruments and observe?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Carry power margin for heater-assisted observations of shadowed terrain.

choices.label: Skip the shadowed pass
choices.tradeoff: No thermal or power risk, but observations in the next 3 days are not flown.

choices.label: Heat the instruments and observe
choices.tradeoff: No science time lost, but the heaters drain 30 % of the battery; if it empties the spacecraft is lost.

scenarioEvents.title: Lunar eclipse: thermal survival
scenarioEvents.situation: A lunar eclipse cuts solar power for several hours and the spacecraft cools quickly.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Enter survival mode or keep operating through the eclipse?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Size the battery for an eclipse with operations still running.

choices.label: Enter survival mode
choices.tradeoff: The battery is protected, but observations and contacts in the next 2 days are dropped.

choices.label: Keep operating
choices.tradeoff: No science or contacts lost, but the battery drops 40 % of its capacity.
